title: Furthest Building You Can Reach - Solution
intuition: Find the furthest building index you can reach using bricks and ladders.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(n log l) where l is number of ladders
common_mistakes: Use a min-heap to keep track of the largest height differences. Use ladders for largest climbs and bricks for others.
